english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for the act or ritual of driving out ghosts or evil spirits.

examples.english: This house used to be haunted all the time, so the owner hired a master to perform an exorcism.
examples.traditional: 呢間屋以前成日鬧鬼，屋主請咗師傅嚟驅鬼。
